hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css|md)$' && npx prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

hooks.prompt: You are an independent code reviewer for a Next.js 16 / TypeScript / Tailwind badminton queue app. STEP 1 - Check for changes: run `git diff --name-only HEAD` and `git diff --cached --name-only`. If there are NO changed .ts or .tsx files, output exactly: 'No code changes - skipping review.' and stop. STEP 2 - Review (only if .ts/.tsx files changed): read each changed file, then write a concise independent code review covering: (1) correctness and logic bugs, (2) React rules of hooks compliance, (3) TypeScript type safety, (4) edge cases and unhandled states, (5) any clear performance issues. Format your response as: ## Independent Code Review **Files reviewed:** [list] [findings - be direct and specific, max 250 words] **Verdict:** LGTM / Minor issues / Needs fixes
